prompts.east_source_v1.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D RPG enemy sprite animation source, original artwork. The reference is the EXISTING amber/orange gel enemy with tiny leaf sprout, not a style sheet to copy into this output. Maintain this exact creature identity: small friendly round translucent golden-orange slime with glossy warm highlights, dark brown eyes and small mouth, one green stem bearing two green leaves. Match its soft hand painted chibi game-sprite shading. A regular 4 by 4 grid of 16 isolated full-body poses, generous empty transparent gaps, no grid lines or text. Row1 four breathing idle poses; row2 four squash-and-stretch locomotion poses; row3 four physical gel body lunge/attack poses; row4 two recoil/hurt poses followed by two death poses with wilted leaves and flattened puddle. No weapons, no equipment, no fireball/projectile/magic/VFX, no new features or limbs. Transparent background, no ground shadows. Preserve leaf anatomy, stable body volume/color and readable silhouette across animation. ALL sprites face EAST/right in genuine side profile; eye and mouth located toward right-facing front edge. Use one visible near eye as appropriate for this side view, not a frontal two-eye face. Draw independent side-specific poses, not a horizontally flipped frontal view. Keep feet/puddle within its own cell.
